race.comment: I LOVE THIS SONG (6) went back early from his wide draw over this trip at Murray Bridge last time but hit the line strongly into a midfield finish. Easier here and from a kinder draw he will take plenty of stopping. EASY BEAST (3) bounced back to somewhere near his best form last time when finishing fourth at Murray Bridge after being in contention on the turn. At his top now and has enough dash to offset the wide alley. HASTA LA AMNESTY (4) defied a lack of market support last start, scoring with plenty in hand here. This is his optimum trip with three wins from four starts and shapes as a key runner. IRLANDAIS (5) was in the money two starts back at Hamilton but was unable to repeat the effort last time when finishing alongside ILTS at Murray Bridge. Is right in the mix on his best form.
